title: derby01: damage
description: How hits hurt. A hit lands in a zone of the car (front, rear, or one of four quarters); the rubber bumper there takes a share; what is left dents the bodywork, cracks the glass, wears the parts behind it and comes off the chassis health. dv is how hard the knock was, as a change of speed in m/s.

zones.description: Damage factor by where the car is hit: ramming with your front hurts you least.

crash.description: Two cars colliding: each takes (dv - threshold) × per.

threshold.description: Knocks softer than this (m/s) don't hurt.

per.description: Damage per m/s above the threshold.

wall.description: A car hitting the edge, a building or a post: (dv - threshold) × per.

ignore.description: Knocks softer than this (m/s) are not even felt.

threshold.description: Knocks softer than this (m/s) don't hurt.

per.description: Damage per m/s above the threshold.

props.description: Factor for posts, trees and other round things that don't give way.

landing.description: Coming down hard after a jump (speeds are how fast the car falls, m/s).

knock.description: Landings harder than this shake the crew and throw dust.

hurtAbove.description: Landings harder than this hurt the chassis.

hurt.description: Chassis damage per m/s above hurtAbove.

radarAbove.description: Landings harder than this shake the radar.

radar.description: Radar damage per m/s above radarAbove.

tyresAbove.description: Landings harder than this wear all four tyres.

tyres.description: Tyre wear per m/s above tyresAbove (a tyre has 100).

axleAbove.description: Landings harder than this may break an axle.

kick.description: How a knock throws the car about: it rolls and pitches away, hops on a hard one, and its tyres skate for a moment.

min.description: Knocks softer than this (m/s) don't throw the car.

roll.description: Body roll per m/s of a side knock (looks only).

pitch.description: Body pitch per m/s of a knock from the front or back (looks only).

stun.description: Seconds the tyres skate per m/s of the knock.

stunMax.description: The longest they skate, in seconds.

radarAbove.description: Knocks harder than this shake the radar loose.

radar.description: Radar damage per m/s above radarAbove.

liftAbove.description: Knocks harder than this lift the car off the ground.

lift.description: Upward speed per m/s above liftAbove.

liftMax.description: The fastest a knock lifts the car, in m/s.

bumpers.description: How much of a hit the rubber takes where it is hit (it takes less as it wears).

crash.description: Share of a crash between cars.

wall.description: Share of a hit on a wall or a building.

gun.description: Share of a paintball that hits the rubber.

wear.description: The bumper loses this many times what it soaks up.

lowHit.description: Paintballs only hit the rubber below this height, in metres.

fatigue.description: Metal fatigue: this share of every hit can never be repaired.

kitGun.description: Paintballs wear the kit's add-on parts at this share of their damage.

parts.description: What a hit does to the parts behind it: the engine at the front, the fuel tank at the back, the tyres, the axles and the guns.

engine.description: Engine damage per point of damage to the front.

leakGun.description: Chance a paintball in the back holes the fuel tank.

leakCrash.description: Chance a hard knock in the back holes the tank.

leakCrashAbove.description: How hard (m/s) that knock must be.

tyreGun.description: Tyre wear from a paintball near a wheel, low down (a tyre has 100).

tyreCrash.description: Tyre wear per m/s of a knock near a wheel, above tyreCrashAbove.

tyreCrashAbove.description: Knocks softer than this (m/s) don't wear the tyres.

axleAbove.description: Knocks at either end harder than this (m/s) may break that axle.

gunJamAbove.description: Crashes harder than this (m/s) may jam the gun at that end.

fireLeakGun.description: Chance a paintball sets a leaking tank on fire.

credit.description: Who gets the credit when a car hits a wall or is wrecked after a hit.

hit.description: Seconds after a hit in which wall damage and a lost radar still count for whoever hit it.

wreck.description: Seconds after a hit in which a wreck still counts for whoever hit it.

bodywork.description: Collision damage accumulates on each panel after bumper absorption. Panels first loosen, then a later hard collision can release them after a visible delay. Paintballs do not loosen panels. Wrecks shed a bounded set of remaining parts.

panelDamage.description: Collision wear required before a later hard hit can release an already loose panel.

panelImpact.description: Minimum collision speed change in m/s to release a panel.

panelHit.description: Minimum damage after bumper absorption on the releasing hit.

wheelImpact.description: Minimum collision speed change in m/s to tear away a damaged wheel.

wheelHit.description: Minimum damage after bumper absorption on the wheel impact.

wheelRadius.description: Maximum horizontal distance in metres from the impact to a wheel.

wheelHeight.description: Maximum impact height in metres above the car origin for wheel loss.

wheelTyreHp.description: Tyre health at or below which a hard hit may tear the wheel away. A flat tyre or broken axle also qualifies.

wreckPanels.description: Maximum remaining panels released when the car is wrecked; front doors have priority.

wreckWheels.description: Maximum remaining wheels released when the car is wrecked.

panelLooseDamage.description: Collision wear required to loosen the struck panel before it can detach.

panelLooseTime.description: Minimum simulation seconds spent loose before a later qualifying collision can detach the panel.
